Stonehold Castle

Raised stone by stone upon the open plains, Stonehold guards the road with a water-filled moat, a drawbridge and a twin-towered gatehouse.

The Gatehouse

Pass the drawbridge and the iron portcullis. Guards keep watch from the room above the gate, reached from the wall-walk.

The Keep

The great hall below holds the lord's throne and feasting tables. This floor is the lord's chamber and library; above it, the barracks and armory.

The Walls

Stairs in the courtyard climb to the battlements. Four corner towers hold arrows and ladders to their crenellated tops. Keep the lanterns lit!

args.summary: Stonehold Castle is finished. It's surrounded by a moat you cross on a drawbridge into a gatehouse with two round towers, an iron portcullis and a guardroom above the gate. Behind it are crenellated curtain walls and four corner towers with ladders to their battlements. In the courtyard you'll find a well, a stable, a working smithy with a smoking chimney and stairs up to the walls. At the back stands a three-storey keep with a slate roof and four corner turrets, the largest one 38 blocks tall. Inside the keep are a great hall with a throne and banners, the lord's chamber with a library, a chest and a lectern chronicle, and the barracks and armory on the top floor. The last check found only 5 spots where mobs could spawn, all on ledges you can't walk to.
